name: Mateo Garcia
headline: Python Backend Developer
summary: Python backend developer with 4 years of full-time experience in travel tech, plus two years of concurrent freelance API work for e-commerce clients.

experience.title: Backend Engineer
bullets: Maintain the booking engine's Django back office used by 120 travel agents across Argentina and Chile.
Cut fare-search response time from 2.4 s to 600 ms by caching supplier responses and rewriting the slowest PostgreSQL queries.
Moved email and voucher generation to Celery, removing timeouts during flash sales.
Introduced Docker-based local environments, taking new-hire setup from two days to one hour.

experience.title: Freelance Python Developer
bullets: Delivered REST APIs in FastAPI for four e-commerce and logistics clients alongside my full-time role.
Built a Python inventory-sync service linking two marketplaces to a client's warehouse, covering 15,000 SKUs.
Modelled product catalogues in MongoDB for a fashion retailer and wrote its nightly import job.
